purpose: FS-10 Production store export after Production Verification (runbook §7; FS-10-DEPLOYMENT.md P4): the backup before any Founder Release decision

source.state_as_of: seq <= 64, 2026-10-01 after verification and revocation; the table held exactly 64 rows (seq 1-64, no gaps)

method: read-only SQL through the operator's Supabase connection (select seq, partition, base64(record), sha256(record)); each record accepted only when sha256 of the decoded bytes equals the database's value (64 of 64); written with fullstack/deploy/backup.py line_for, re-read with parse and summary. No write, no application credential
server_digest_query: select partition, count(*), sum(octet_length(record)), min(seq), max(seq), encode(sha256(string_agg(record, '\x0a'::bytea order by seq)),'hex') from aios_records where seq <= 64 group by partition
export_check: backup.summary(parse(file)) equals every partition's server count, bytes and joined digest; whole-table joined digest equal
content: verification data only: 57 access-audit records (subject fs10-verification or null), 2 runs (Scenario B succeeded, Scenario C failed), 5 trace records; no agent instance
